# Clipping

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A clipping captured by the Obsidian Web Clipper browser extension that was developed by Steph Ango (Obsidian CEO).

## Scope note

Web Clipper automatically uses a template to populate metadata about the source in Obsidian properties (YAML frontmatter), in addition to the web content.
